name: SurviAGI 搜索与提交
description: 在 SurviAGI 搜索已发布的 AI 进展，并用你在 surviagi.com 生成的 API Key 提交研究问题、推荐值得监测的 X 账号（均为待审核申请，不会自动启动研究或采集）。
description_en: Search SurviAGI's published AI progress, and with the API key you make on surviagi.com submit research questions and suggest X accounts to monitor (requests for review; nothing is researched or collected automatically).
examples: 帮我查一下 AI 法律助手的进展；如果没有相关研究，就把这个问题提交给 SurviAGI
推荐 @某个账号 给 SurviAGI 监测，理由是……
examples_en: Look up progress on AI legal assistants; if nothing covers it, submit the question to SurviAGI
Suggest @someone to SurviAGI for monitoring, because ...
